artifacts.notes: The content-delivery route https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_decree_19641121_orientalium-ecclesiarum_en.html returned a byte-identical 33012-byte response with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-24; the alias is not duplicated. The response contains the complete numbered body, translated promulgation formula and date, and consolidated notes. Its HTML title, description, and keywords misspell the incipit as Orientalium ecclesiarium although the visible heading is correct. In article 26 the body markers for notes 31 and 32 are reversed relative to the note content, Latin web witness, and Acta witness. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

passages.context: The complete English article was inspected for the Council's desire that the permanent diaconate be restored where it had fallen into disuse and for its separate treatment of the subdiaconate and minor orders.
passages.notes: The legislative-authority clause governs the subdiaconate and minor orders and their rights and obligations, not regulation of the permanent diaconate. Current capacity and implementation require CCEO and applicable particular and local controls; the article's earlier sources are leads rather than inherited evidence.

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on the Catholic Eastern Churches, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 21 November 1964. Its numbered articles 1-30 address the Churches' dignity, patrimony, governance, sacramental discipline, worship, and relations with separated Eastern Churches.
work.title: Orientalium Ecclesiarum
